cohort: 402 cases of prenatally diagnosed Trisomies 13, 18, and 21 at a tertiary referral unit from 2005-2015
finding: While Trisomy 18 was the most likely diagnosis to result in miscarriage, IUD, or intrapartum death, live birth rates show that some parents may achieve the goal of spending time with their baby in the immediate postpartum period.
mod_finding: The highest cesarean delivery rate was observed in pregnancies with Trisomy 21.
